title: How to create a Pick List from PSINV (Draft or Paid)?

posts.name: Peer
posts.cooked:
We have cashiers in the store, but the items are picked in the warehouse (by the cashier or warehouse employees, depending on available staff and affluence of the moment).

How can a Pick List be created from a PSINV (POS Invoice)? These generally are already paid when picking starts.

I didn’t find any option to do this, differently from how it works with normal SINV.

What would be the best path to find (or build) this functionality? Or workaround?

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @Peer

Pick, Pack and Ship is something designed to cater B2B selling cycle in ERPNext dynamically.

B2C selling does not offer such luxury to put on hold a customer in line and go to pick an item. POS doctypes does not cover such function naturally.

posts.name: Peer
posts.cooked:
We serve B2C and B2B.
Most of it via shipping of parcels and palettes.
But we still have a shop on premises where customers can come and get items immediately (if stock). So they come and leave with items and even pallets of items. Depending on the client’s operations (or household) size.

Sometimes there is some waiting in line (depending on the season), but apparently it’s worth it for getting items immediately, as opposed to waiting for a shipment and the additional cost. Some are from close by (or drive around anyway), so they drop in and get what they need from us.

So, while you explain some understandable reasons why the standard modules are what they are, in our case it’s not that clear-cut of a difference as you describe.

Anyway, there will be means to satisfy the requirements one way or another.

A client script behind an additional button on the PSINV to create a pick list from it shouldn’t be too complicated I guess and could probably be modeled after the corresponding button of the SINV form/controller.
On the other hand, I might have missed some configuration option or another trick which makes this unnecessary, so I thought it might be useful to ask.
